decisions.reason: As a flagship product line with its own page that fits the firm's digitalisation direction, it meets aspirations in a growing firm with slack, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The education institute builds on the firm's established training content and customer relationships, and a growing firm has the slack to carry it while its results are still uncertain, though it is less central than the software.
The remote screen-sharing tool is a low-cost support utility tied to the core service, so it gives little reason to reallocate its resources.
